note: oracle = stop the instant the last kept ground-truth neighbour entered the result heap, per shard, on this same ef=48 trajectory; upper-layer descent is not refundable. waste_split divides (ref - oracle) by whether the shard returned any true neighbour in its final result: 'empty' contributed nothing (mostly the partitioning tail (1-1/S)^K, plus a few percent of shards that held an answer but missed it -- at S=1 it is only the latter), 'useful' is confirmation after the last kept answer arrived.
